items.title: Super typhoon may enter PAR next week
items.description: A potential super typhoon is expected to enter the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) next week, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration said yesterday.

items.title: Philippine removes 250,000 fake overseas job posts
items.description: The Philippines has worked with social media platforms Meta and TikTok to remove about 250,000 online posts advertising fraudulent overseas jobs, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) said.

items.title: Zaldy Co’s bagmen, Baligod arrested for unjust vexation
items.description: Fourteen alleged bagmen of ex-lawmaker Zaldy Co and their lawyer Levi Baligod have been ordered arrested yet again, this time by a Zambales court for unjust vexation.

items.title: Ombudsman: Plunder cases vs Legarda, Leviste filed soon
items.description: A plunder case against Sen. Loren Legarda and her son, Batangas Rep. Leandro Leviste, will be filed before the Sandiganbayan soon as the complaint undergoes preliminary investigation, Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla said.

items.title: VP: Tackle SALN issues in court, before ombudsman
items.description: Vice President Sara Duterte on Thursday said the Senate impeachment court and the Office of the Ombudsman are the proper forums to answer allegations that she failed to declare properties linked to her family.

items.title: 60 percent think some senators won’t be fair in impeachment trial
items.description: While there will be some senators who will be impartial, a majority of Filipinos believed that there will be some who would not be fair in their decision in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, a survey conducted by Pulse Asia showed.

items.title: Self-rated poverty highest so far this year – SWS
items.description: More than half of Filipino families considered themselves poor in the third quarter of the year, the highest so far in 2026, based on a survey conducted by Social Weather Stations (SWS).

items.title: Philippines beaches, Palawan on Conde Nast spotlight
items.description: Coron and El Nido in Palawan and Boracay in Aklan have once again put the Philippines on the global beach map as they landed among the world’s top beaches in Condé Nast Traveler’s lat-est list.

items.title: Gas prices tipped for P4.20/liter rollback
items.description: After two consecutive rounds of hikes, gasoline prices may finally drop by at least P4 per liter next week amid easing supply concerns in Asia.

items.title: DepEd: Wearing of school uniforms optional amid El Niño threat
items.description: Students are no longer required to wear school uniforms as part of the measures to address the adverse effects of the super El Niño expected to persist until next year, Education Secretary Sonny Angara announced yesterday.

items.description: The Ayala chairman wants an 'honest conversation' on Philppine investments and talks teamwork to a roomful of rivals at Makati Business Club's sapphire anniversary

items.description: From challenging Big Tech to protecting independent journalism, Maria Ressa offers a roadmap for fighting authoritarianism in the digital age

items.description: A soothing, hydrating skin facemask formulated to calm stressed, breakout-prone skin and replenish moisture

items.description: Sources say leaders at the Defense Department received a message that the SpaceX Starshield service for the Ukrainian military needed to be slowed

items.description: An expert says the 'era of high fertility' that drove the country to overpopulation is over

items.description: The hiring push comes as scrutiny of AI-agent safety grows in China and the US, especially as developers give them autonomy to access the Internet

items.title: Ukraine hits Russian refinery as Zelenskyy says ‘we’re done’ with Trump’s energy truce

items.title: 11 Negros Occidental wind projects advance along bird migration route
items.description: Concerns regarding the projects' impact on bird migration routes are being addressed, and the developments align with the province's goal to transition to renewable energy and reduce reliance on fossil fuels

items.title: FACT CHECK: Plane with drugs not same aircraft used to fly Duterte to The Hague
items.description: The tail number of the aircraft used to transport former president Rodrigo Duterte to The Hague does not match that of the jet carrying suspected illegal drugs from Laos, contrary to claims in social media posts
